title: Graduated Return After Military Service: Length of Service
content:
For a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a servicemember whose military service, counted in calendar days from the service start date to the end of military service, lasted at least 365 days adds 2 graduated-return due dates; one whose service lasted at least 180 but fewer than 365 days adds 1; any other servicemember, including one whose benefit carries no captured end of military service, adds none. The service start date and the end of military service are those captured on the benefit.

| Calendar days of service | Graduated-return due dates added |
|---|---|
| 365 or more | 2 |
| 180 to 364 | 1 |
| fewer than 180, or no end of military service captured | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, service start 1 March of a non-leap year)

- End of service 27 August: 179 days, none. End of service 28 August: 180 days, 1.
- End of service 28 February of the next year: 364 days, 1. End of service 1 March of the next year: 365 days, 2.
